name: Netorasezuma, Miina ~Hoka no Otoko no Te de Shiranakatta Kaikan o Ajiwai Midareru Wakazuma~
original_name: ネトラセ妻、美衣奈 ～他の男の手で知らなかった快感を味わい乱れる若妻～
source:
Two years have passed since he married his kind and gentle wife, Miina. The protagonist, Jun, is without a doubt at the peak of happiness even now.

Their newlywed life has been smooth sailing, work is going well, and not even one problem has come up with each others' parents or relatives...

... Well, that's not the whole story.

There is one small problem that Jun has: a sexual fetish he can't control.

The happier he gets, the bigger his wild fantasies become. He knows most people wouldn't understand, so he manages his problem by secretly venting online to people who share the same fetish.

However, one day Miina ends up finding out about his secret...

[Translated from [url=http://www.at-sakura.net/ntr/brand/099/index.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
他和温柔善良的妻子Miina结婚已经两年。主角Jun无疑仍处于幸福的巅峰。

新婚生活一帆风顺，工作进展顺利，与彼此的父母或亲戚之间也没有任何问题……

……当然，事情并非如此简单。

Jun有一个小小的烦恼：他无法控制自己的性癖。

越是幸福，他脑海里那些狂野的幻想就越强烈。他知道大多数人不会理解，因此只能偷偷在网上向有相同癖好的人倾诉，借此排解。

然而有一天，Miina发现了他的秘密……
